description: Erection of a two bedroomed house adjacent to the existing house and construction of a vehicle crossover.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (SSCD 8424/PL01, SSCD 8424/PL02, SSCD 8424/PL03, SSCD 8424/PL04, Planning Statement produced by SSC Architecture & Project Management and Noise Exposure Assessment Report 10877-NEA-01 produced by clement acoustics and dated 17 February 2016. All received 18/02/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the dwelling hereby permitted shall match those specified in the application and sos far as practical match those used in the existing building at 121 Shelley Crescent.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the occupation of the dwelling hereby approved, a splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays. The splay shall be maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the dwelling hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises hereby permitted or any additional structures/buildings within its curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 7 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied and so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 8 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the submitted plans full details of the proposed cycle store, including space to store 3 bikes, shall be submitted and approved prior to the first beneficial occupation of the dwelling hereby approved and this shall be so maintained at all times thereafter.

Condition : 10 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Noise Exposure Assessment and shall achieve the recommended internal noise levels as specified in Table 5.1 of British Standard BS8233:2014. 
Prior to the occupation of development post completion noise tests shall be carried out by accredited/approved organisations in order to demonstrate that this has been achieved. Noise tests shall be carried out taking account of worst case environmental conditions, such as easterly operations at Heathrow, peak time traffic flows wind speed, direction and presence of temperature inversion. Continuous logged data shall be submitted, together with parameters measuring LAeq, 16 hours during day-time (07:00 - 23:00) and Bedroom = 30 dB LAeq, 8 hours during night-time (23:00 - 07:00), LA90 for day and night and LAFmax at 1m from external fa?ade.
